intro: This quest sends an Alliance courier from Astranaar eastward to the ancient outpost of Forest Song. Carrying a scouting missive from Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire, travelers seek out the druid Kayneth Stillwind to help him monitor the spread of corruption across the ancient woods.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The druid Kayneth Stillwind sent word to me. He would like a report of the happenings along our coast and in the forests surrounding Astranaar. He fears there is a corruption moving through Ashenvale... And he may be right.
Here, take my report to him. You will find him in the shrine of Forest Song, in the Nightsong Woods to the east.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have something for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, Shindrell's report! Many thanks, friend. Shindrell is a fine sentinel, brave and keen. I must read this for clues of a wickedness I fear is moving through Ashenvale.
